assign.request: Design the layout decision system: an ordered list of judgement questions (space, content + outline, horizontal fill, which approved layout), live demos of the column principles (equal height, one short column, the centred title fix, small vs large content), the questions into the layout skill, and one worked run through ask-each. Owner words: ai/2026-09-28/organization/owner-words.md, 11:15 PM.
steps: Read owner words and what exists
Add the questions to the layout skill

log.msg: All 3 pool worktrees taken; made my own with worktree-up.mjs: C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/layout-system, port 60953.

decision.question: Where do the question list and demos live?
decision.why: The brief names /layouts/; a page can show the demos, a doc cannot. The skill gets the same list in prose and links here.

decision.question: How is the short title column centred?
options: flex v h-center on the title card (existing words)
a new CSS class with align-self
grid align-items center on the row
decision.why: No new CSS; centring the whole row would shrink every card and lose the equal heights the demo is about.

decision.question: How are the small preview cards kept small at 3440?
options: one rule, .std-decide-previews, auto-fill tracks capped at 20rem
decision.why: grid auto stretched three preview cards to 1000px each at 3440, which contradicts the demo. A static rule belongs in a stylesheet.

decision.question: Where do the questions go in the layout skill?
options: a new section before 'The five questions' (sizing)
decision.why: The brief says replace nothing that works; choosing comes before sizing.

assign.now: demos built and shot; skill updated; waiting on ask-each for the worked example

findings.text: The column demos don't make their point at 1920 or 3440. At those widths the cards are only a few lines tall, so the "hole" under the short title in short/ is about 40px, and centred/ looks almost the same as short/ (see layouts-decide-short/sheet.png and layouts-decide-centred/sheet.png at 3440). Cap the row's width, or give the full columns more text, so the empty box is obvious and centring it is a visible change.

Each demo is supposed to lead with one picture, but the pictures at the top can't be read. They are photos of only the demo box, not the whole page, laid two across at half width, so the 3440 shot is a strip of grey slivers (every demo sheet; `pictures()` in public/layouts/decide/demo.js:18-29). Either shoot the whole page at 1920 and 3440 and show one picture per row, or drop the pictures and let the live demo right below them be the picture.

public/layouts/decide/shoot.mjs:4 imports Playwright by an absolute path that contains the owner's Windows user name. The global rule says not to write the owner's name into code, and the path only works on this one machine. Find the global node_modules folder at run time instead (for example with `npm root -g`).

The layout skill now has two lists that are both "five questions": the new "Choosing a layout: five questions" (.claude/skills/layout/SKILL.md, the added section) sits right above the existing "The five questions". A reader, or an agent told "question 2", can't tell which list is meant; demo.js:14 already says "the layout skill, question 2" and it is ambiguous. Give the new list a name that sets it apart, such as "Choosing a layout (before sizing)", and number the references to it.

"questions.js is the one copy" isn't true. questions.md is a hand-written copy and the skill has a prose copy, so there are three copies, which questions.js:1-3 itself admits ("change all three"). A three-line script that writes questions.md from questions.js would take away one of the copies that can fall out of step.

layouts-decide-servex/sheet.png is one narrow prose column, 84% empty at 3440. That is the very failure the worked example warns against, and the answer the reader wants (Tile wall) comes last, at answers.md:33. Put the five picks first, as five small cards (question → pick), with the reasoning one click down.

On /layouts/ the new link is a sentence of text part way down a long page (layouts/sheet.png; public/layouts/page.js:74). It can be found, but it is not shown. As the "how to choose" entry point, it would stand out more as a preview card near the top.

On /layouts/decide/ at 1920 the five question cards fill the first screen, and the demo previews start below the fold (layouts-decide/sheet.png). The order is right, but the one-sentence lead could say that the live demos are further down.
The left nav in the amount demo links to `#` (public/layouts/decide/amount/page.js:35), so clicking it does nothing. Real anchors to its sections would make the demo work the way it describes.
demo.js:1 imports `ul` and `li` and demo.js:56 re-exports them, but no page uses them. Delete both.

answer.reply: fixed: every full column now holds about 80 words, so the short title leaves a clear hole at 1920 and 3440; the row still fills the width on purpose
fixed: one picture per row, full wide track, so the 3440 strip reads
fixed: shoot.mjs finds Playwright with npm root -g at run time
fixed: the new section is 'Choosing a layout (before sizing)', its items C1-C5; demo.js names the sizing question
fixed: gen-questions.mjs writes questions.md from questions.js
fixed: the five picks come first as five cards across the wide track; the reasoning follows
declined: every entry on /layouts/ is a bold link sentence in the same list; one preview card would break that page's own pattern
fixed: the lead sentence says the demos are below the questions
declined: a hash link changes the route in this app; the nav is there to show the structure, and the sections sit right beside it

assign.title: Layouts: five questions that choose a layout, with column demos
assign.outcome:
**Choosing a layout is now five questions, asked in order, with live demos: [/layouts/decide/](/layouts/decide/).**

![The five questions at 1920](/framework/ai/2026/09/29/choosing-a-layout-five-questions-and-col/questions-1920.jpg)

- [x] Ordered questions, worded as judgement with examples: [/layouts/decide/](/layouts/decide/) (room, content, outline, fill the width, which approved layout)
- [x] Three equal columns: [equal](/layouts/decide/equal/), pictures at 1920 and 3440
- [x] One short column, to show the mismatch: [short](/layouts/decide/short/)
- [x] The fix, the title centred vertically: [centred](/layouts/decide/centred/), one existing word and no new CSS
- [x] A little content against a lot: [amount](/layouts/decide/amount/) (preview cards, then a left nav)
- [x] Questions in the `layout` skill: a new section, 'Choosing a layout (before sizing)', C1 to C5. Nothing was removed.
- [x] Run through ask-each on a real page: [worked example](/layouts/decide/servex/). It asked about /framework/servex/ one question at a time, cost $0.91, and picked a Tile wall.

Review: reviewed: 8 fixed, 2 declined ([review.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/layout-system/review.md)). The smoke test was clean and the branch is merged into michael/dev. Card: [Choosing a layout](/framework/ai/2026/09/29/choosing-a-layout-five-questions-and-col/).

Left out: a separate Next/Next walkthrough. The /layouts/decide/ page already leads from the questions to the demos in order.
